name: Does scanning a document upload it anywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Every step — the camera capture, the corner detection, the crop, the perspective correction — happens locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to PDFree's servers or anywhere else. You can verify this yourself by opening your browser's DevTools Network tab while scanning.

name: Why does every photo I add show a crop screen, even from my gallery?

acceptedAnswer.text: This tool is built specifically for scanning documents, so every photo — camera or gallery — goes through the same edge-detection and crop review, exactly like a dedicated scanner app. If you just want to combine existing photos into a PDF without cropping, use PDFree's JPG to PDF tool instead — it skips the review screen for a faster, simpler combine.

name: What if the automatic edge detection gets it wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drag any of the four corner handles to adjust the crop before confirming. If detection doesn't find a confident edge at all, the tool starts you with a safe default crop that you can freely reshape.

name: Can I skip cropping for a photo that isn't a document?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. On the review screen, choose Skip instead of confirming a crop — the original photo is added to your PDF unprocessed.

name: Does it work in color, or only black and white?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both, and more. Grayscale (the default) whitens the background and sharpens text — best for plain documents. Color corrects uneven lighting while keeping the real colors of the page. B&W turns the page into pure black text on white. Faded text keeps pale or faint writing from washing out. Original keeps the photo as it is. Brightness and contrast sliders fine-tune the result.

name: Can the scanned PDF be searchable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Turn on Recognize text for a searchable PDF and choose the document's language: the text is recognized in your browser and saved in the PDF, so you can search and copy it. If text recognition isn't available on your device, a regular PDF is saved and the tool tells you.

name: Can I scan multiple pages into one PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Add as many photos as you need — from the camera, your gallery, or both — reorder them by dragging, and they're combined into a single PDF when you save.
